# The car body dimensions are 200 (length) x 100 (width) x 100 (height)
# Wheels are to be placed at the bottom corners, half embedded (so 5 units into the body)

front_right = (25, 75, 5)

# Positions for the rear wheels (x, y, z)

rear_right = (175, 75, 5)

# Return the positions

    "front_left": front_left,
    "front_right": front_right,
    "rear_left": rear_left,
    "rear_right": rear_right
}
wheel_positions"}
